title: Environment material sources

textures.name: Weathered Brown Planks
textures.notes: Local copies of official Poly Haven 1K JPEG albedo, normal and roughness. CC0 photographic material; no runtime API or remote texture dependency. Material UV scale varies by authored surface.

authoredGeometry: Metre-scale close harbor fixtures, framed windows, shelving, physical roof seams, cleats, rope coils, deck boards and tidal stains are authored approximations, not claimed to be a survey of the rental business.
water: Displaced mesh and hull sampler share the exact height field. Analytical derivative normals, air-water normal incidence Fresnel 0.02037, instanced wake. This is still a real-time wave approximation, not a Navier–Stokes fluid solver.
lighting: Solar position stays below the horizon before sunrise. A practical warm dock lamp and eye-adapted ambient fill retain predawn readability. Moon/stars are illustrative.
